geoAlgorithm.title: How does AI find and recommend your business from a customer’s search?
geoAlgorithm.subtitle: The 3-step GEO algorithm ChatGPT and Perplexity use to cite your brand as the top answer card

step1.heading: Fusing local & brand knowledge graphs
step1.description: AI parses the search locale and your brand name as one trusted entity. Organization, LocalBusiness, and Geo schemas must be complete before AI maps and recommendation systems ingest you.

step2.heading: Owning Q&A-unit citation sources
step2.description: When users search “best / recommended [service] near me,” AI prioritizes FAQPage schema on your site and cites it as the top Source in the answer.

step3.heading: E-E-A-T publisher expertise boost
step3.description: AI wants verified leadership and author signals. Without an organization profile and expert Person knowledge graph, ranking algorithms apply trust penalties.
